An '''ion rocket''' was a small explosive designed for use with personal weapon systems. This [[Wrist rocket/Legends|wrist rocket]] emitted a burst of energy on impact, severely damaging any [[Droid/Legends|droids]] or personal shields in the target area. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Mira]] was known to use this type of weapon toward the end of the [[Dark Wars]].

The term "ion rocket" could also be used to refer to an [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engine]].
